candidates.title: A costing framework for fusion power plants (Woodruff et al., 2026)
candidates.notes: Accessible (CC BY-SA 4.0). Covers pyFECONS baseline: ARIES-style CAS accounts, BoP benchmarking via Bechtel pilot study, standardized cost accounts aligned to IAEA/GEN-IV/EMWG/EPRI lineage. Directly addresses BoP cost structure gap.

candidates.title: Extension of the fusion power plant costing standard (Woodruff et al., 2026)
candidates.notes: Accessible. Extends pyFECONS with MFE/IFE/MIFE architecture-specific cost tracks, probabilistic costing with TRL/learning-curve uncertainty, and financial metrics (NPV, IRR, MIRR, WACC). Adds full cost-account development for dominant drivers per confinement class.
